theme_and_archetype.archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast - Dark Mode Adaptation) mixed with Jewel & Luxury surface strategies
theme_and_archetype.rationale: SaaS platform requiring functional clarity for dashboarding, mixed with premium 'NotesDrive.shop' aesthetics using dark navy and electric blue.

buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium bg-transparent border-2 border-[#1E293B] text-white hover:border-[#3B82F6] hover:text-[#3B82F6] transition-all duration-200
buttons.glass: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur-md hover:bg-white/10 transition-all

badges.popular: absolute -top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-3 py-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0EA5E9] to-[#3B82F6] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must lighten their background or border on hover and include a subtle translateY(-2px).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion: initial opacity 0, y 20 -> animate opacity 1, y 0. Staggered children (staggerChildren: 0.1).
motion_and_interactions.flashcard_flip: Framer Motion 3D rotateY(180deg) for card flip animation. Preserve-3d on parent, backface-hidden on child.
motion_and_interactions.active_glow: Focus states must drop a soft electric blue shadow (0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)).

media_and_images.guidelines: Images MUST be dimmed with an overlay if text sits on top (e.g., max overlay bg-[#0A1929]/70).

hero_background.description: Abstract dark dynamic tunnel effect in blue tones for the hero section background.

student_studying.description: Student studying with a laptop at night, use for the 'About' or 'Study Tools' section.

pharmacy_abstract.description: Floating pill blister packs on a teal background, use for B.Pharma category card.

code_abstract.description: Computer code on dark screen, use for B.Tech category card.

Homepage.layout: Hero Section (glass nav, huge 3D layered text, dynamic background), Features Bento Grid, Semester Pass Banner CTA, Footer.
Homepage.specifics: Hero needs a large glowing CTA. Use the glassmorphism header.

Pricing.layout: 3-column grid for plans (Free, Pro, Elite). Pro card is scaled 1.05x, has an electric blue border and glowing drop shadow. Feature comparison table below the cards.
Pricing.specifics: Semester Pass (₹249) highlighted in a wide card below the 3 primary columns. All pricing in INR (₹).

NotesLibrary.layout: Search Bar top. Tablist below (BTech, B.Pharma). Nested filter pills. Grid of note cards.
NotesLibrary.specifics: Free users see a lock icon over the 'Download' button on Note Cards. File size and download count styled with small Phosphor icons.

StudentDashboard.layout: Control Room Grid (Dense). Top right: Plan Badge. Main charts: Study progress. Lists: Downloaded notes history. Widgets: Exam countdown timer, Mock test scores, AI usage tracker (out of 3 for free users).
StudentDashboard.specifics: Use Shadcn Progress component for subject-wise progress bars and AI usage tracker.

AIPDFSummarizer.layout: Centered layout. Large dashed Drag & Drop zone. Chapter-wise summary displayed in Shadcn Accordion component.
AIPDFSummarizer.specifics: Claude API integration note. Progress bar showing usage limits. 'Upgrade to Pro' CTA if limit reached.

FlashcardTool.layout: Split view or focused mode. Center screen holds the large 3D flip card. 'Next/Previous' controls below.
FlashcardTool.specifics: Spaced repetition progress tracker at the top. Flip animation via Framer Motion.

MockTestEngine.layout: Header with sticky timer. 1 question per view or full scrollable list. Radio group for options.
MockTestEngine.specifics: Timer turns red in last 5 minutes. Result screen shows a large circular score, correct/wrong list, and a leaderboard widget.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against the navy background meets 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text should not fall below #64748B.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: All buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and user balances MUST include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='pricing-pro-plan-cta').

tech_stack_instructions.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react (default). Phosphor preferred for high-end SaaS feel.
tech_stack_instructions.ui_library: shadcn/ui primitives. Customize radii to 'rounded-xl' and colors to match the dark navy/electric blue palette.
tech_stack_instructions.animation: framer-motion for interactions. react-fast-marquee if scrolling announcements are needed.
